changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE public.product ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), updated_date TIMESTAMP(6), description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, spr_column_6 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_7 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_8 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_9 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_10 NUMERIC(19, 2), product_type VARCHAR(255), segment_type VARCHAR(255), repayment_type VARCHAR(255), spr_column_14 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_15 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_16 NUMERIC(19, 2), spr_column_17 NUMERIC(19, 2), CONSTRAINT product_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_product_name UNIQUE (name) );
CREATE SEQUENCE public.product_id_generator START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1;

rollback.sql: DROP SEQUENCE public.product_id_generator; DROP TABLE public.product;

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.scoring ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), product_id BIGINT, CONSTRAINT scoring_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_scoring_product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES public.product (id) );
